prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate-loading for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals from breakfast through dinner in a single day
Includes pre-training, during-training, and post-training nutrition timing
Carbohydrates comprise 60-65% of total daily calories to support endurance training
Plan is presented in compact, concise format (under 400 tokens)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate-loading, with specific macronutrient ratios and timing around training windows

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength and power development for weightlifting with muscle recovery between training sessions
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegetarian, limited budget (meals under $3 per serving)

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly one day with clear meal timing
All meals are vegetarian and cost-effective
Includes minimum 1.6g protein per kg body weight daily from plant-based sources
Incorporates recovery nutrition between training sessions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with dietary restrictions (vegetarian) and a limited budget, requiring protein-dense meal options and recovery nutrition between sessions
